findings.title: Destructive tool exposes no authorization surface
findings.description: The tool appears to mutate state or move money, but its schema declares no confirmation, approval-token, or dry-run argument. Execution is gated only on the model choosing to call it.
findings.remediation: Add a confirmation or authorization argument (or a dry_run default) to every state-mutating tool, and enforce it server-side - not just in the schema.
